description: This file defines a generic interface ILookupDataResponse<TLookupData> within the BlazorShared.Interfaces namespace. It specifies a contract for responses containing a list of lookup data objects, constrained to types derived from LookupData.

classes.name: ILookupDataResponse
classes.description: A generic interface representing a response that contains a list of lookup data objects.

methods.name: List
methods.description: A property that gets or sets a list of lookup data objects of type TLookupData.
